answer: We formalize a Sybil-resistant mechanism where each identity must lock an opportunity-cost bond within a decentralized ledger partitioned across a secure shale topology. The protocol employing an opal-based zero-knowledge delay function forces adversaries to harbor high capital allocations, guaranteeing that the staking collateral C exceeds any potential double-spend payoff V. By structuring subgame-perfect slashing matrices where the expected utility U = V - C(1+d) is strictly negative, the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest participation.
